caption: Share a screenshot from Preview or Finder to the chat item in the Share menu, and it waits in a chat's composer.

steps.title: Another app shares a picture
cmux:
command=printf '\033]0;Preview\007'; clear; python3 -I -c "import struct, zlib; w = h = 160; row = b'\x00' + b'\x3c\x8c\xe6' * w; c = lambda t, d: struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t + d)); open('/tmp/share-demo.png', 'wb').write(b'\x89PNG
\x1a
' + c(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) + c(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(row * h)) + c(b'IEND', b''))"; printf 'import AppKit
let u = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/tmp/share-demo.png")
if let s = NSSharingService.sharingServices(forItems: [u]).first(where: { $0.title.hasSuffix(" Chat") }) { s.perform(withItems: [u]) }
RunLoop.main.run(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(5))
' > /tmp/share-demo.swift; printf '
  Share > Chat
'; sleep 3; xcrun swift /tmp/share-demo.swift; sleep 900

steps.title: The picture waits in the chat's composer
